gap_investigation.sdpa_control_verdict: INCONCLUSIVE, reported rather than spun. SDPA n=2 clean gave 0.959029 at 1384 steps vs FA3 0.932028 at 1993 steps; token-law correction (b=0.06) predicts +0.0219 of the +0.0270 observed, leaving a +0.0051 residual that EXCEEDS the +0.0025 effect under test. The control is confounded because DOC_MASK_IMPL had to change dense<->varlen alongside the backend (varlen requires fa3), so it is not a one-variable swap, and 2 of 4 seeds were contention-hit (654/664 steps) and quarantined.

tokenizer_provenance.WHY_THIS_MATTERS: val_bpb normalizes by BYTES, and token_bytes.pt IS that byte denominator. The reconciliation's frozen_files pins train.py/lib.py/observable.py/prepare.py/data_split.json but NOT the tokenizer artifact, so a host rebuild silently redefines the metric. This is a real reproducibility hole in the campaign setup, recorded here because it is a leading candidate for the +0.0025 gap vs the historical reference and cannot currently be ruled out.
tokenizer_provenance.determinism_note: text_iterator() iterates shards and row-groups in fixed order with no sampling, so training is deterministic GIVEN the same rustbpe version. The rustbpe version used for the historical reference runs was never recorded, so byte-identity with the historical tokenizer cannot be verified.
